test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 'Promotion of educational and economic interests of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and other weaker sections' comes under which Article of Indian constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 46**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Article 46 of the Indian Constitution mandates the promotion of the educational and economic interests of Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), and other weaker sections.
 
• This article is part of the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP), which are guidelines for the framing of laws by the government.
 
• Article 46 aims to protect these communities from social injustice and all forms of exploitation.
 
• The state is encouraged to take special care to promote their educational and economic development.
 
• It highlights the importance of equal opportunities and upliftment of marginalized communities in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP)**

 
 
• These principles are enumerated in Part IV of the Indian Constitution, from Articles 36 to 51.
 
• DPSP aims to create social and economic conditions under which citizens can lead a good life.
 
• They act as guidelines for the central and state governments in India to frame laws and policies.
 
• Though non-justiciable, DPSPs are fundamental in the governance of the country and aim to establish a welfare state.
 
 
 
• **Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST)**
 
 
• These are officially designated groups of historically disadvantaged people in India.
 
• SCs and STs have been provided with certain privileges and reservations in educational institutions and government jobs to promote their development.
 
• The Constitution of India recognizes the need for affirmative action to uplift these communities.
 
 
 
• **Social Justice**
 
 
• Social justice refers to the fair and just relation between the individual and society.
 
• It includes the distribution of wealth, opportunities, and privileges within a society.
 
• The aim is to create a society based on equality and solidarity, where human rights are recognized and protected.
 
 
 
• **Educational and Economic Development**
 
 
• Educational development involves providing access to quality education for all, especially marginalized groups.
 
• Economic development includes measures to improve the economic conditions of weaker sections through employment, entrepreneurship, and financial inclusion.
 
• Both aspects are crucial for the holistic development of individuals and communities.
